posts.text: [Image] Three scanned pages show a purported White House executive order titled “Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence,” dated September 29, 2026. The text directs executive agencies to use “Super Intelligence” and “SI” instead of “Artificial Intelligence” and “AI,” defines the terms, and outlines implementation provisions. The final page bears an illegible handwritten signature.

sentiments.label: neutral
sentiments.rationale: The text neutrally describes scanned pages and the contents of a purported executive order without expressing approval, criticism, or other sentiment.
